schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines

dimensions.definition_quote: The majority of journals (94.4%) explicitly stated that AI tools could not be listed as authors because they did not qualify for authorship.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: Generative AI, including language models, chatbots, image creators, machine learning, or similar technologies do not qualify for authorship.

dimensions.definition_quote: Nearly three-quarters of the journals (72.2%) emphasized the responsibility of human authors for the scientific integrity and content of the manuscript.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: Authors bear the responsibility for the scientific integrity of the content generated by AI.

dimensions.definition_quote: A small proportion of the journals (16.7%) limited the application of AI tools for translation and language improvement.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: authors are allowed to use AI-assisted technologies (such as LLMs, chatbots, image creator, or other) only for English correction or translation

dimensions.definition_quote: All journals (100%) required authors to declare the use of AI tools in some form.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: At submission, authors must disclose whether they used AI-assisted technologies (such as LLMs, chatbots, or image creators) in the production of submitted work.

dimensions.definition_quote: Some journals (27.8%) required authors to provide specific information on AI technology, such as name, version, and manufacturer.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: authors using AI should declare this fact and provide specific technical details about the AI model used, including its name, version, source, and the method

dimensions.definition_quote: A minority of the journals (16.7%) provided templates for AI-usage disclosure statements.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: During the preparation of this work the author(s) used [NAME TOOL/SERVICE] in order to [REASON].

dimensions.definition_quote: Nearly half (44.4%) of the guidelines included phrases that discouraged the use of AI tools for content generation such as text, images, and figures.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: Using AI technologies in creating or altering figures, images, and artwork is discouraged unless such use is part of the research design or methods.

dimensions.definition_quote: Some guidelines (22.2%) included statements on the consequences of non-disclosure, such as rejection or retraction.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: Manuscripts that fail to include necessary information regarding content generated with the assistance of AI may be rejected from review

dimensions.definition_quote: Over one-third of journals (38.9%) mentioned exemptions from the declaration requirement for the use of basic tools or AI solely for enhancing linguistic quality
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: The use of AI tools to enhance the linguistic quality of a submission is considered acceptable and does not require specific disclosure.

dimensions.definition_quote: One-third of the guidelines (33.3%) instructed authors to include a statement in the cover letter.
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: it is essential for the authors to disclose how it was used in both the cover letter and the manuscript itself

dimensions.definition_quote: Regarding the location of the AI declaration, some guidelines specified which section to state it
dimensions.locator: Key components of artificial intelligence policies in Korean medical journal guidelines
dimensions.quote: Authors must disclose the use of generative AI and AI-assisted technologies in the writing process by adding a statement at the end of their manuscript

schemes.scheme_name_verbatim: PAIRED — Process-Anchored Interaction Reporting for AI-Enabled Discovery
schemes.empirical_basis: three decision points drawn from the development of a published preprint on AI-assisted swimming coaching

dimensions.definition_quote: PAIRED organizes the research process into four stages: Ideation, Design, Execution, and Reporting.

dimensions.definition_quote: The Evaluator role has two subtypes that PAIRED treats as distinct.
dimensions.quote: Evaluator-G (generative) denotes interactions in which AI generates alternatives that it then assesses, with the researcher choosing among AI-produced options.

papers.reason: empirical analysis of the CMS Open Payments database; the payment-type categories (e.g. Royalty or License, Consulting Fee, Food and Beverage) classify financial conflict-of-interest transfers to physicians, not the disclosure, attribution, or provenance of an authored or produced work; the paper's own Author Contributions (CRediT) list is a routine boilerplate statement, not a scheme the paper proposes or analyzes
